resources.description: This resource is designed to develop a sense of what logarithms are, how they can be used and the sort of values they take. A set of short video clips demonstrate the use of 'log tables' to perform a selection of multiplications and other calculations.

resources.title: How fast does it grow?
resources.description: This resource provides a framework for exploring the difference between an exponential and a power of $x$, thinking about values of expressions and also the graphs of their functions. This could be used either as a quick introductory activity or as a more open-ended investigation.

resources.title: Logarithm lattice
resources.description: This resource asks students to arrange some logarithms in size order and complete a grid. Students have to think about different bases as well as logarithms of different numbers. The task starts with specific numbers but can be generalised to thinking about increasing and decreasing logarithmic functions.
